maria (PM): Quick sync — I'm drafting the go-live acceptance we present to GTM tomorrow. Need alignment on SLA targets, docs gating, oncall coverage, monitoring SLOs, and whether pricing needs to be baked into GA or can be 'preview'.
aj (Eng): Quick take: we can hit p50 120ms, p95 ~380ms for hosted if we lock batching and KV cache defaults. 99.9% availability is reasonable but needs playbooks for region fallback.
kevin (SRE): +1 on fallback playbooks. Clarify what counts as downtime for SLA — API 5xx only or also high error-rate responses? We should define error budget math.
lina (Docs): Docs gating question — do we require full runbook + troubleshooting guide and per-route cost examples before GA, or can we ship a condensed troubleshooting FAQ and expand post-GA? Docs effort is ~2 engineer-weeks for full runbook.
maria (PM): My proposal: GA requires runbook + condensed user-facing FAQ; detailed internal runbook can land within 2 weeks after GA. SLA contract should reference API-level errors (5xx and timeouts).
oliver (FinOps): Pricing note: if GA advertises committed pricing tiers, we need quoting + billing tests done. Otherwise mark pricing as "preview" and include estimated unit costs on the pricing page. Billing tests take 3 days.
aj (Eng): On monitoring: we need p50/p95 latency dashboards, token-level cost breakdown per model, per-route error rates, and a few alerting rules: 1) p95 latency spike, 2) error-rate > 1% for 10m, 3) cache hitrate drop > 20%. We can wire those by EOD Friday.
kevin (SRE): We'll own oncall for GA week but need the escalation matrix finalized. Suggest: primary SRE + product oncall in first 2 hours, then handoff to infra team. Also add automatic fallback policy so requests route to compatible model variant if capacity constrained.
maria (PM): Sounds good. Decision items for tomorrow:
- SLA numerics: availability 99.9% (targets), p50 150ms, p95 400ms (hosted).
- Docs gating: public runbook + FAQ required for GA; internal runbook within 14 days.
- Support: SRE primary for first-response GA week; product in pager rotation for first 2 hours.
- Monitoring: dashboards + three alerts (latency, errors, cache hitrate).
- Pricing: mark as 'preview' for self-serve; enterprise committed pricing behind dedicated contracts.
Can folks +1 or flag major blockers?
lina (Docs): +1 for public runbook + FAQ. I'll start the FAQ template and add explicit examples for token cost calc.
aj (Eng): +1 assuming we ship with the cache defaults and batching config. We'll lock those in config PR today.
kevin (SRE): +1 but need the exact SLAs in writing for legal review (downtime definition). I'll draft the error budget calc and post it here.
oliver (FinOps): +1 on preview pricing. I'll prep billing test plan and run it Wed-Thu.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started to 3% traffic for model-serving runtime. Logs: OK so far. :eyes:
maria (PM): Great — thanks. Kevin, can you post the SLA wording and error budget calc by EOD? Lina, start the public FAQ with a short template (how to read latency numbers, how pricing is estimated). Aj, lock the batching defaults PR and ping when merged. I'll incorporate these into the GA readiness slide for tomorrow.
kevin (SRE): Will do. Draft incoming in ~3 hours.
aj (Eng): PR up in 30m.
lina (Docs): FAQ draft by EOD.
maria (PM): Perfect. If anything unexpected pops during the canary, call it out here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
